console.text: > open portal.nusadigital.test  →  Error: site security certificate is not yet valid (computer clock mismatch)

note.text: Lestari: yesterday I changed the laptop date to test a meeting reminder, then forgot to change it back. Now every office site refuses to open.

explanation: A site's security certificate (a digital ID card with a validity period) is checked against the laptop clock, so a date set back to 2020 makes sites get rejected even though the network is fine. Fix it by turning automatic time setting back on.
hints: The portal replies to ping. So why is the site still rejected?
Compare the laptop date with the office server time.
